description:
Read the properties and relationships of a deletedChat object.

TIP: Gets a specific deleted Teams chat by ID. Returns the same fields as list-deleted-chats plus members (snapshot of participants at deletion time) and viewpoint (per-caller chat state). Use before calling undo-delete-chat to confirm the chat identity and the participants who will regain access on restore.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-deleted-chat
